about_the_game:
SHEEP is a challenging, surreal first-person herding adventure that takes you through pastures, mountains, space, and pocket dimensions.

🐑 Lead Your Flock – Control Woolsworth to guide your flock. Use clever movement and positioning to solve puzzles and traverse treacherous terrain.

⚔️ Challenging encounters - Fast-paced fights that reward sharp reflexes and clever use of your surroundings.

🌍 Explore the Surreal - From grassy hills to rainy chasms, lava caverns, and starry arenas—each level is a strange new world with its own secrets and threats.

📖 Uncover Hidden Realms - Secret access points transport you to six optional levels full of traps, puzzles, and battles—including a chaotic finale.

**All side levels include a built in timer and best time bulletin board. WELCOME SPEEDRUNNERS!

🌀 Gain Magic Abilities - Find hidden crystals to unlock powerful new moves

🎶 Original Soundtrack - Let a playful, emotional score carry you through each strange new world.

short_description: Become The Shepherd, follow the call to adventure.  Beware the unknown as the Entity’s machinations unfold... ...The fate of your flock—and your own—hangs in the balance. Will you guide them home, or will you be lost to the ether?
